subject: Mosaic: Vendor record setup & PO contact confirmation
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@mosaictech.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mosaic Tech Accounts Payable <ap@mosaictech.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Mosaic: Vendor record setup & PO contact confirmation

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Finance is ready to add Redwood as an approved supplier in our ERP, but they need a few items to complete the vendor record so POs can be routed automatically.

Attached are the items AP asked for (W9 + our suggested PO workflow). To help us map POs correctly, can you confirm the following from your side?

- Legal entity name to populate the vendor legal name field
- Remit address for invoices (street, city, state, ZIP)
- Preferred AP contact for PO questions (name, email, phone)
- Tax ID (we only need the last 4 digits for confirmation over email)
- Do you accept PO-based ACH payments? If yes, please include the ACH remittance contact.

We'd like to get this into our system by EOD Tuesday to hit our month-end cutoff.

Thanks —
Emily Zhang
Senior Finance Operations
Mosaic Technologies
Attachments: W9_MosaicTech.pdf (application/pdf), Mosaic_PO_Workflow.xlsx (spreadsheet/xlsx)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@mosaictech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Mosaic: Vendor record setup & PO contact confirmation

Emily —

Appreciate the note and the attachments. We're happy to move quickly on this. Answers below — I copied Ben (procurement) and Marissa (finance ops) to handle onboarding and payment setup.

- Legal entity name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit address: 2101 San Pablo Ave, Oakland, CA 94612
- Preferred AP contact for PO questions: Accounts Receivable Team <ap@redwood.ai> (primary), alternate: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.ai, +1 415-555-0124)
- Tax ID: last 4 digits 4321
- ACH / PO-based payments: Yes — we accept ACH for PO payments. ACH remittance contact: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>; see note about required bank onboarding below.

Next steps on our side: Ben will confirm the internal vendor code and provide the legal docs (Certificate of Incorporation) if you need them for vendor verification. Marissa will share the bank onboarding sheet for ACH enrollment (we'll also route this back to your AP team).

If you want a short mutual action plan:
1) You confirm vendor fields in Mosaic ERP (legal name + remit address + AP contact).
2) We send bank onboarding form and Certificate of Incorporation (by EOD today).
3) Your AP ingests vendor and confirms vendor code; we test a $0/ACH remittance verification if required.

Happy to do a 15-minute call if that helps speed the process.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Partnerships Operations
Redwood Inference

1) Can you confirm whether Redwood Inference, Inc. has any DBA / trade names we should list on the vendor profile?

Best,
Emily
